meta.name: Mismatched
meta.description:
After a disastrous set-up by their families, two teens strike up a tentative friendship at their summer program - but deeper feelings aren't far behind.

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/6 (missing E5) | S2 8/8 | S3 8/8

videos.title: When Dimple Met Rishi
videos.overview: Hopeless romantic Rishi hopes to woo Dimple at a summer course after seeing her photo on a matrimonial website — but marriage is far from her mind.

videos.title: Hot Summer, Cold Vibes
videos.overview: Dimple learns why she was really allowed to come to Jaipur. Bonding with Dimple during a class assignment, Rishi hopes they'll be paired for a project.

videos.title: Message Deleted
videos.overview: After a less-than-fun dinner with Celina’s friends, Dimple’s walk home with Rishi proves enlightening. Celina and Namrata both hide secrets.

videos.title: Making Moves
videos.overview: Namrata confides in Rishi about her crush. Emotions run high when a wild house party at Zeenat’s brings surprises and misunderstandings.

videos.title: Games We Play
videos.overview: Dimple devotes herself to her app before a dramatic gaming showdown with Anmol. Multiple betrayals risk relationships, including Dimple and Rishi’s.

videos.title: When Dimple Met Rishi.. Again
videos.overview: Dimple and Harsh seek credit for their app. Namrata faces the aftermath of her secret spreading, while Rishi tries to salvage their friendship.

videos.title: Girl in the Middle
videos.overview: With Namrata and Rishi back on campus, Celina’s anxieties run high, while Dimple and Harsh’s closeness sparks jealousy.

videos.title: 100 Reasons to Hate You
videos.overview: Dimple’s search for the data leak’s source proves challenging. Zeenat offers Sid a home-cooked meal and Anmol makes a discovery that tests his trust.

videos.title: Heartech
videos.overview: Sparks fly at the tech fest in Ajmer as new connections are forged and a dance competition turns heated.

videos.title: Altair and Vega
videos.overview: Love and lust are in the air as a tech-free day on campus leads to new revelations. In therapy, Anmol grapples with the reason behind his anger.

videos.title: You’re The One
videos.overview: As the wedding nears, family drama leaves Rishi anxious. Harsh weighs a major decision about his future, while Celina overcomes her fears.

videos.title: It’s Not a Non-Date
videos.overview: Namrata contemplates her future as tensions run high at home. Serious consequences catch up with Celina and Anmol finds he isn’t alone.

videos.title: I Love You More
videos.overview: A romantic date gets in the way of Dimple’s dream. While the farewell party brings remorse and resolution, Namrata takes a bold step.

videos.title: When Dimple Didn't Meet Rishi
videos.overview: While navigating a long-distance relationship, Rishi’s career soars while Dimple’s life turns stagnant. Sid dreams big with a new educational institute.

videos.title: For Better or For Verse
videos.overview: On Valentine’s Day, Rishi hosts a matchmaking event to test a new app. Tension marks Celina and Rith’s first meeting. Dimple and Rishi take a big step.

videos.title: Chill vs Dil
videos.overview: Dimple’s frustration grows as Rishi splits his attention between the metaverse and Nandini. Zeenat makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: It Gets Better, Hon
videos.overview: Celina plans a dazzling pride event for the students. Vinny dives into student advocacy. Auditions begin for a new stage production.

videos.title: Where Does The Love Go?
videos.overview: A visit to Hyderabad’s historic monuments sparks romance for the students. A surprise wedding brings the gang together. Dimple receives devastating news.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: Dimple struggles to focus but later finds inspiration. Anmol and Vinny spar over his past. Rith uses artificial intelligence to aid his transition.

videos.title: Hello, Future Wife!
videos.overview: An impromptu engagement party sparks happiness and confusion. Celina learns of a major hack, while a remorseful Anmol tries to make amends.

videos.title: Beginning, Middle and...
videos.overview: At Technovate in Mumbai, the launch of Betterverse hits a glitch. The couples face emotional decisions over their futures — together and apart.
